newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Avianca to start London route.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Avianca to start London route.

text.p: Colombia's main airline Avianca will begin flying direct from Bogota to London from May 2, the company said on Tuesday.
The route will be Avianca's fourth direct route to Europe, which currently include Paris, Madrid and Frankfurt.
At present the only other airline to fly direct between Bogota and London is British Airways.
Avianca said flights to London would be twice weekly, adding that it would operate the route with a new Boeing 727-200 with seating for 179 passengers.
An Avianca spokesman said the cost had not yet been announced.
